title: THE FORGE UPGRADES YOUR GUN TO MK II
why: His question of 2026-10-14 (where is the Forge) and his order of 2026-10-12 (a pack-a-punch to upgrade guns, in the raid only). At THE FORGE, E now opens its panel: it shows the gun in your hands against its MK II (damage, magazine and reload before and after) and the price in RAID SCORE, the same in the DEMO and in CAREER. Pick MK II with 1, the mouse or A on a pad and the gun in your hands becomes its MK II: +30 percent damage, a quarter more magazine, a fifth quicker reload, GUN UPGRADED, a hammer and anvil ring, gold sparks, and the pickup card shows the new gun against the old. The ring carries 700 out, so machines and pillagers in earshot come to look: forging is done in the open. MK II costs 2,500 score. With too little it says NEED $2,500 and opens nothing; with no gun it says NO GUN IN HAND. ESC, TAB, B or CLOSE leave with no charge. The panel is not a pause, the raid runs on behind it. The MK III and the elements come next.
now: At THE FORGE press E to upgrade your gun to MK II for 2,500 score. The MK III and the elements come next.
